input.prompt:
A real night photograph of giant digital billboards in a dense city entertainment square: A giant flat LED billboard covers the upper floors of a tower on the square, surrounded by smaller glowing screens.

The output is one single photograph, portrait 4:5.

Composition A, centred and symmetric: the design surface sits on the centre line, square to the camera, with even space on both sides; strong verticals and horizontals run parallel to the frame. Shot: Camera on a raised spot across the square at the billboard height, 135mm lens, f/5.6, square to it. The billboard fills about 55 percent of the frame width on the centre line, sharp; neighbouring screens glow magenta and electric blue at the frame edges; the dark tops of the towers above. Nobody is in frame.

Place: A dense city entertainment square at night: tall towers stacked with giant LED screens, wet asphalt and pavements; every screen except the hero shows only soft solid colour gradients in magenta, electric blue, violet and amber, with no text, logos or pictures.

Light: Night lit by the giant screens: saturated coloured spill across the wet streets and facades; the hero screen is the brightest thing in the frame; clean air, no smoke.

Palette and grade: Deep near-black night with vivid magenta, electric blue, violet and amber spill from the surrounding screens; the hero design surface pure neutral white. The same grade on every image of the collection.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph of a giant digital billboard, so the design surface is the hero: it is large in the frame and the camera is close enough that it dominates. It is a real place on a real wet night, shot from a real vantage point. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are in frame. The hero screen is crisp at its edges and corners, with no bloom around it.

Design surface: THE HERO SCREEN SHOWS A PLAIN WHITE FULL-SCREEN IMAGE, glowing bright and clean, clearly the brightest thing in the frame, evenly lit edge to edge yet not blown out, with crisp corners meeting its thin dark frame; nothing crosses it.

Finish: Shot on a full-frame camera at night like real street photography: fine natural grain, true deep blacks, crisp highlights without bloom; real, never a render, never cyberpunk.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, any image or text on the design surface, tiny people in the street, halation, bloom or glow around the screen, smoke or haze, a sci-fi or 3D render look.
